title: Questions and exclamations

summary_es.en: Intonation: yes/no questions rise, wh-questions fall, exclamations are emphatic.
summary_es.fr: Intonation : les questions fermées montent, celles avec mot interrogatif descendent, les exclamations sont appuyées.
summary_es.zh: 语调：是非问句升调，特指问句降调，感叹句有力。
summary_es.ja: イントネーション：はい/いいえ疑問文は上昇、疑問詞疑問文は下降、感嘆文は強調します。

tip_es: In Spanish yes/no questions rise at the end (¿Quieres venir?). Questions with a question word usually fall (¿Dónde vives?). In exclamations, stress the key word and let the voice fall (¡Qué bonito!). Do not add “do/does” sounds: the intonation does the work.
